subject: Usage adjustment & one-time charge for Q2 post-renewal
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finosolutions.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Usage adjustment following renewal

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well. After we completed our renewal on 2026-06-15 we ran a final usage audit for Q2 and found ~18% more token consumption than forecasted for the committed period. Our accounting team is asking for a one-time settlement to reconcile retroactive usage for the quarter.

I've attached our export (Fino_Q2_usage_report.xlsx) with the daily consumption and the renewal baseline. Can you review and confirm how Redwood wants to handle the post-renewal true-up? Specifically:
- The total overage we've calculated: $16,200 (based on your published per-token rate in the renewal)
- Whether Redwood will apply any pro-rated credit based on committed capacity changes
- Expected timeline for an invoice and PO instructions (our AP email below)

AP contact: ap@finosolutions.com

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Samantha
Billing Lead, Fino Solutions

Attachment: Fino_Q2_usage_report.xlsx (xlsx, 120 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finosolutions.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage adjustment following renewal

Samantha — thanks for the export and call-out. We're reviewing the numbers on our side. Quick notes up front:
- We see the same uplift in tokens for mid-May through June tied to the increased user batch you onboarded.
- Per the renewal, committed capacity covers X tokens/month; overages are typically billed as a one-time settlement.

Marcus (finance) and Grace (CS) are looped in — Marcus will validate the invoice amount and Grace can confirm whether any credits are appropriate for onboarding anomalies.

Can you confirm the AP PO timeline (expected PO by date) and whether Fino expects Redwood to issue an invoice or a credit memo? We'll prepare a proposed settlement and share the breakdown by line item.

If agreeable, I can draft a one-time invoice for the overage and hold for PO before issuing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 at 9:18 AM Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finosolutions.com> wrote:
> Hi Neha,
>

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Usage adjustment following renewal

Confirming I've reconciled their export against our ingestion logs. Summary:
- Fino overage tokens (net): 9,800 tokens equivalent for the quarter
- Published per-token rate in their renewal: $1.65 per 1k tokens -> gross overage: $16,170
- Suggested commercial concession: 10% one-time reduction given the onboarding spike used for a short window = $14,553 final

Attached is my calculation sheet (calc_breakdown_20260703.csv) with line-level math and the invoice line items I'd propose.

Recommendation: issue a single one-time invoice for $14,553, hold for PO. If AP needs a formal amendment, we can generate a short statement of work addendum to capture the one-time charge.

Marcus
Manager, Revenue Operations

Attachment: calc_breakdown_20260703.csv (csv, 6 KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finosolutions.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Usage adjustment following renewal

Thanks Marcus & Neha — that aligns with our internal math. Two small asks before we can cut a PO:
1) Can Fino get a PDF of the proposed invoice and the short amendment language (if any) for our legal/AP review?
2) Can Redwood confirm billing alias and whether the invoice should reference the renewal amendment number? Our AP team requires the renewal reference to match (Renewal #R-20260615).

AP will target PO issuance by 2026-07-12 once they review the docs.

I attached a signed amendment stub that indicates the baseline changes — it's not the final billing doc but should help legal.

Samantha

Attachment: signed_amendment_stub.pdf (pdf, 35 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finosolutions.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage adjustment following renewal — final invoice & next steps

Samantha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the stub. Finalizing on our side:
- One-time settlement amount: $14,553 (10% concession applied).
- Invoice reference: Renewal #R-20260615, Invoice ref: R-20260615-OT-001.
- Billing alias: accounts-payable@redwood.com (please route PO to this address).

Attached: invoice_draft_20260708.pdf — this is draft and will be finalized once we have the PO number from your AP team. Expected invoice terms: Net 30.

Next steps:
1) Samantha/AP: confirm PO number and email it to accounts-payable@redwood.com by 2026-07-12 (you indicated they will target that date).
2) Redwood: upon receipt of PO we will issue the final invoice and route to AP, and we will also upload the signed amendment to the HubSpot deal.

Grace — please note: if AP requests a credit memo flow instead of a one-time invoice, advise and we'll convert the draft. Marcus — please sign off on final invoice once PO is received and confirm ledger code to use.

Thanks all — happy to jump on a 15-min call if we need to expedite.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_draft_20260708.pdf (pdf, 18 KB)
